title: GeneratorOutput
description: The versioned contract for what a generator emits (Step 2R, WP2R.4). One document per Ensemble. Tensors are pinned by shape/dtype/sha256 digest (ah.core.digest canonical float64 rounding), never embedded: the document is the auditable description of an ensemble, and the arrays live wherever the run put them. Components a generator does not produce (a bootstrap has no slow states) are declared absent with a reason - absence is a statement, not an omission.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this generator-output contract.

provenance.description: The provenance quartet (generator, checkpoint, config, vintage) plus the seed and block set - everything needed to name what produced the arrays. Mirrors EnsembleMeta.

generator_id.description: The registry id that produced this ensemble (ah.gen.registry). Must resolve.

checkpoint_hash.description: Content hash of the trained checkpoint, null for generators with no trained weights (bootstrap, Gaussian control).

config_hash.description: Content hash of the sampler/training config, null where no config object exists.

vintage_id.description: The data vintage every fitted artifact and reference statistic came from.

seed.description: The single base seed all randomness flowed from (PCG64; path k opens base_seed + 7919*k).

active_blocks.description: The factor blocks (factors.yaml factor_blocks) this ensemble was generated over.

factors.description: The factor namespace, in paths[:, :, i] column order. Copied from the sealed factor manifest (factors.yaml) at emit time; an agreement test, not this schema, asserts the copy is faithful. n_factors must equal the length of this array.

block.description: The factor block (factors.yaml) that declares this factor.

kind.description: The primitive-vs-derived split, stated explicitly. 'series' = primitive, read from one registered series; 'derived' = computed by a named ah.data.derive helper; 'unavailable' = generated but with no Step-1 source (reference statistics do not exist for it).

units.description: Units of this factor's generated values: the requirements.yaml units for a series factor, the manifest's declared units for a derived one. Null is permitted only for kind=unavailable, where no sourcing series exists to carry units (enforced by the conditional below).

identity.description: For kind=derived: the defining identity, sufficient for a consumer to recompute the variable from its inputs. For series/unavailable: null.

expr.description: The ah.data.derive function name that defines this variable.

inputs.description: The requirements.yaml series ids the identity consumes, positional, in the order the helper expects.

arrays.description: Digest descriptors for every tensor the ensemble carries. 'paths' is always present; the others mirror the regimes / slow_states blocks (present as a descriptor exactly when the block is present, else null).

regime_labels.description: (n_paths, months) integer codes into regimes.labels_legend, when the generator produced a regime path.

slow_states.description: (n_paths, months, n_states) in slow_states.names order, when the generator ran a slow-state layer.

regimes.description: The regime path the ensemble was generated under, or an explicit absence.

labels_legend.description: Integer code i in the regime_labels tensor means labels_legend[i]. For regime_ruleset_v1 this is the six Step-1 labels in ah.data.derive order.

mode.description: How the path arose: 'semimarkov' (fitted skeleton), a WorldSpec regimes.mode, or a generator-specific mode string. Recorded verbatim from the run.

ruleset_version.description: The regime ruleset the labels are defined against (e.g. regime_ruleset_v1).

slow_states.description: The slow-state layer (L1) the paths were generated under, or an explicit absence.

names.description: State names in the slow_states tensor's last-axis order (the climate model's STATE_NAMES contract).

layer.description: Whether the slow states were simulated from the posterior or frozen at its mean (ablation system C).

diagnostics.description: The waypoint/diagnostic block: what the joinery did and how well, or an explicit absence for generators with no joinery.

waypoints_bound.description: Whether annual waypoints were computed and bound (Denton reconciliation ran). False for the rollout ablation.

reconciliation.description: Per-factor reconciliation-diagnostic distribution across paths, as emitted by the joinery.

support.description: Support-monitoring summary (Mahalanobis exceedances against the reference).

conditioning.description: The generator's full conditioning record (EnsembleMeta.conditioning), verbatim. Deliberately open: its contents are generator-specific lineage, and the sealed conditioning statements - not this schema - govern what conditioning is permitted.

tensor.description: A tensor pinned by shape, dtype and content digest. The digest is ah.core.digest.sha256_of_arrays over the single array (canonical float64 rounding), so any holder of the array can verify it against this document.

sha256.description: ah.core.digest.sha256_of_arrays output, prefix included - the platform's digest convention.

absent.description: An explicit absence: the generator does not produce this component, and the document says why instead of leaving a reader to infer it.

reason.description: Why this component does not exist for this generator (e.g. 'bootstrap-v1 has no slow-state layer; blocks are drawn from the historical panel').
